raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`validate_deepseek_v41_features` only accepts Mooncake for DeepSeek-V4.1 DSpark PD, so `--disaggregation-transfer-backend mori` fails at startup. The V4.1 DSpark PD support is backend-agnostic: the layout and TP checks run in `CommonKVManager.try_ensure_parallel_info`, and MoRI already transfers the target and draft SWA states through its generic state path.

## Modifications

Accept `mori` next to `mooncake` in the V4.1 DSpark PD check and update the error message.

## Accuracy Tests

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, 1P1D on one 8x MI355X node (prefill TP4 + decode TP4), DSpark, MoRI, `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.21-rocm724-mi35x-20261003` + this PR:

| Test | 1P1D MoRI | Aggregated (reference) |
|---|---|---|
| Needle at 213 / 1.1K / 2.7K / 5.4K / 21K / 110K prompt tokens | all correct | all correct |
| GSM8K 5-shot, 400 questions | 0.907 | 0.900 - 0.910 |
| DSpark accept length (decode) | 3.46 | 3.4 - 3.5 |
| Chat with thinking, tool call | correct | correct |

With the UMBP direct linker on the prefill side (#42197), a 110K-token prompt after `flush_cache` on both servers restores 110,080 cached tokens and produces greedy output identical to the cold run.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A: this only widens a startup check; the transfer path is unchanged.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -291,14 +291,14 @@ def validate_deepseek_v41_features(server_args: ServerArgs) -> None:
 
         if (
             read_ragged_verify_mode() is not RaggedVerifyMode.STATIC
-            or cfg.disaggregation_transfer_backend != "mooncake"
+            or cfg.disaggregation_transfer_backend not in ("mooncake", "mori")
             or cfg.enable_prefill_cp
             or cfg.attn_cp_size != 1
             or cfg.dcp_size != 1
         ):
             raise ValueError(
-                "DeepSeek-V4.1 DSpark PD requires static verify, Mooncake, "
-                "and CP=1 on both servers. DP attention is supported when "
+                "DeepSeek-V4.1 DSpark PD requires static verify, Mooncake or "
+                "MoRI, and CP=1 on both servers. DP attention is supported when "
                 "both servers use the same block size and target/draft KV layout."
             )
